info.title: Optically isolated LED switch
info.question: Can an LED control a separate electrical circuit?
info.expected: Closing S1 lights the internal input LED; its photocurrent enables D1 on the separate output supply. CTR and output headroom limit transferred current.
info.try: Close S1; select OC1 to compare input/output currents and effective CTR. Change CTR and Restart. The two supplies use separate wiring and common zero-volt measurement references.
info.limitation: Generic LED/phototransistor optocoupler: separate conductive input/output ports, CTR and smooth saturation. No isolation-voltage rating, capacitance, propagation delay, temperature or ageing model.
